decision_conditions:
Reason : 1 - The proposed development, in terms of its 1st floor conservatory element, would result in the loss of the visual gap between Nos 50A and 48 Fairhazel Gardens, which would have a detrimental effect on the disposition between built and unbuilt space in the local streetscene. As such, it is considered to detract from the character and appearance of the Swiss Cottage Conservation Area contrary to policies EN1, EN13, EN14, EN16, EN18 and EN31 of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000 and advice in the Swiss Cottage Conservation Area Statement.
Reason : 2 - The proposed new building, by reason of it taking up most of the existing private open space on site, blocking the only window to bedroom 2 of No 50A Fairhazel Gardens, and overlooking the  rear gardens and habitable rooms at 48, 50 and 50A Fairhazel Gardens and 45 Greencroft Gardens, would have a detrimental effect on the amenity of residents of these properties, contrary to policies RE2, EN1, EN19 and EN23 of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000.
Reason : 3 - The proposed additional parking provision, by reason of the location of the carspaces and need to manoeuvre over the roots of the existing beech tree, subject of a Tree Preservation Order, would result in serious damage to this tree and harm its longterm survival, contrary to policies EN16, EN35, EN61, and EN31 of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000.
Reason : 4 - The proposed basement rooms would not recieve adequate daylight and would not comply with Council standards on light to basement habitable accommodation, contrary to policies EN1 and EN19 of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000 and advice in the Council's Supplementary Planning Guidance.
description: The demolition of an existing single storey electricity sub-station and the erection of a new two-storey and basement dwelling house adjacent to 50A Fairhazel Gardens.
